# 📦 Release Notes — {{RELEASE_DATE}}

## 🚀 Android Support

* Compatible with **Android 15–17 ROMs**
* Tested on **Evolution X**, **InfinityX**, **crDroid** and **LineageOS 24.0** (Android 17), and **AxionOS 2.9** (Android 16)

---

## 📝 Before Flashing

* Back up your **boot.img** and **vendor_boot.img** first
* The zip replaces the kernel and removes the old kernel modules from **vendor_boot**; to go back to your previous kernel, restore both images
* A clean flash is recommended for best stability

---

## 🐞 Bug Reporting

* Report any bugs or issues you run into
* Always include logs and clear steps to reproduce

---

# ⚠️ Disclaimer

* **Flash at your own risk**
* Compatibility with other ROMs or configurations is **not guaranteed**
